description: BODYPUMP HEAVY™ is tempo-based weightlifting class that switches on your metabolic engine to build lean muscle like nothing else. Drawing on traditional lifting techniques, each class challenges strength, builds lean muscle, and drives measurable performance gains. It’s simple to do and the slow tempo with lots of recovery periods allows for expert coaching, so you master form and technique. Driven by iconic music and group energy, it turns traditional weightlifting into a fun, social, and addictive experience. Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

Hot Yoga Members are invited to enjoy the ideal space and environment in our Hot Yoga Studios to indulge in, explore and deepen their own practice at their own pace. The regulated temperatures of the room and peaceful vibe promote your individual journey and choice of movement or meditation to connect to your strength, confidence and inner peace.      
(Temperature will be set at 95 degrees, please bring your own yoga mat, and note that blocks and straps will not be available.  Social Distancing and capacities in effect, space is very limited & sanitization protocols in place)
A creative mix of low impact, step, and sculpting to provide fun in a challenging format that will guarantee you results in a short period of time.  Ideal for all fitness levels.

NEWBODY is a GoodLife Fitness exclusive class that combines the best of cardio and strength training that is functional in nature.  We integrate both light hand weights 1-3 lbs and resistance tubing in this low impact, multi-level workout ideal for all bodies and abilities.  Whether you are new to group fitness or looking to build additional strength and stamina NEWBODY will help you keep you fit for life.

RPM™ is an indoor cycling class where you control your own resistance levels and speed. Set to great music, RPM takes you on a journey of hill climbs, sprints and flat riding that will build your performance and boost your cardio fitness. It’s fun, low-impact and motivating! Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

GoodLife’s multi-level Yoga class will take participants through a number of poses (asanas) designed to increase flexibility and increase stamina while releasing the mind. Unwind in this gentle, non-competitive environment while learning basic breathing techniques and proper body alignment.

BODYPUMP™ is THE ORIGINAL BARBELL CLASS™, the ideal workout for anyone looking to get lean, toned and fit – fast. Using light to moderate weights with lots of repetition (reps), BODYPUMP™ gives you a total body workout. Using scientifically-backed moves and techniques, you will leave the class feeling challenged and motivated, ready to come back for more! Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

Make muscle, burn calories, lose fat!  An effective total body muscle conditioning workout utilizing a variety of equipment and options.  A great complement to any cardio workout and recommended for all members.

BODYATTACK™ is a high-energy, sports-inspired workout with moves that combine athletic movements like running, lunging and jumping with strength exercises such as push-ups and squats. With options for everyone, this class caters to all fitness levels! Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

A 30 or 45-minute integrated core workout inspired by elite athletic training principles, LES MILLS CORE™ is a scientific core workout that builds strength, stability and endurance in the muscles that support your core, including the abdominals, glutes and back. All the moves in LES MILLS CORE have options, so it’s challenging but achievable whatever your level of fitness. Improved balance, injury prevention and improved ability to perform everyday activities are some of the benefits you will achieve with LES MILLS CORE. Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

Hot Yin Yoga is a form of yoga, held in a heated room, that is devoted to releasing the power of your body by increasing energy flow through its Meridians - this means a MORE DYNAMIC YOU. Targeting the deeper connective tissues such as the ligaments, bones, joints and, primarily, the fascia Yin Yoga utilizes longer held poses - 3 - 5 minutes or more; the perfect complement to the traditional stronger yoga‘s. Done primarily on the floor, at first Yin Yoga may seem slow, passive and soft, but you will soon discover that it can be quite challenging in its own way.

LES MILLS PILATES™ features classic mat Pilates movements – with a twist. With core moves, unique music and supportive coaching, it takes the Pilates experience to a whole new level. There’s no need for expensive equipment, and each workout has been tested and iterated to leave you feeling strong, uplifted and calm. Please note, actual workout length is 45 mins. Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

BODYBALANCE™ is a new generation yoga class that will improve your mind, your body and your life. A series of simple yoga moves, elements of Tai Chi and Pilates are set to inspiring music that will leave you feeling calm and centered. Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

A breath focused class that blends ambient music, guided breathwork, and simple movement. Designed to improve breath control, enhance mental clarity and focus, and reduce stress. Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

Zumba is a ""feel-happy"" dance fitness workout that combines high energy Latin flavored music with unique moves and combinations. Zumba is based on the principle that a workout should be ""Fun and easy to do"" so join the party and check out the new routine!

LES MILLS Strength Development™ is a sequence of 45-minute progressive workouts aimed at those wanting to get stronger. Whether new to lifting or a seasoned pro, LES MILLS Strength Development will build muscle, improve technique and grow your confidence to train more powerfully in the studio and on the gym floor. Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.
Using a platform and risers, step your way into strong legs, butt and heart!  This multi-level class is designed to increase your heart health and strengthen your muscles.

BARRE - Come participate in this fun combination of Ballet, Pilates and body-weight sculpting. This class focuses on small, controlled movements primarily targeting the core and upper and lower body muscle groups, which will not only tone your muscles but improve your flexibility and balance.

BODYCOMBAT™ is a high-energy martial arts-inspired workout. You'll learn how to punch, kick and strike your way to superior fitness and strength. A non-contact workout with no complex moves to master, you’ll release stress, and feel like a champ! Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.
Focusing on using the breath to enhance each pose, this flowing yoga class will move seamlessly from one pose to the next allowing for a powerful practice sure to heat the body and release the mind.

A 55-minute cardio dance workout ranging in intensity from Low to Moderate to High impact. Using Indian folk and Bollywood styles, the program consists of well-balanced, transitional choreographies with unique energetic yet artistic moves. No Dance background required!

GoodLife’s indoor freestyle cycling class. This class will increase your cardio and strength while taking you through a series of flat roads, hills, sprints and drills. Low-impact, but high energy, this multi-level class will motivate you through music and moves that will keep you coming back!

LES MILLS DANCE™ is an innovative dance workout to progressive global sounds. Simple to follow but incredibly energetic, this 45-minute cardio-based class is perfect for anyone who loves the mental and physical empowerment of dance! Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness. BODYJAM® is a combination of today’s hottest music and movement styles. It starts with an easy and engaging warm up, leading to an isolations track to bring awareness to moving our bodies, and includes two separate cardio dance blocks. You’ll explore Hip-Hop, Contemporary, Latin and more genres. This cardio workout utilizes high movement repetition to help participants feel confident, successful and most importantly…. LIKE A DANCER! Note, during this class, the Instructor and the participants may be facing the mirrors.

BODYSTEP™ is an exhilarating and fun full body step workout that will leave you feeling strong, agile and inspired. Easy-to-follow functional and strength training will challenge your muscles, develop coordination and improve your cardio fitness for everyday performance. This workout is perfect for all fitness levels, with uplifting music to inspire you to push your personal limits. Exclusive to GoodLife Fitness.

The heat allows for deep, safe stretching while strengthening the body through a series of seated, standing and supine postures. Be sure to bring water and a small towel for a comfortable experience!
